name: DecisionScore
description: Explainable multi-criteria decision intelligence: ranks options against weighted criteria and reports how stable that ranking is (Decision Stability Index) and how much a weight would need to change to flip it (Decision Flip Point).

name: PatternSense
description: Discovers and quantifies patterns in structured/tabular data: pairwise correlations and categorical associations, each reported with a Pattern Transfer Score (PTS) measuring how consistently the pattern holds across independent partitions of the data. Distinguishes association, correlation, temporal relationships, and (caller-hypothesized) causal-hypothesis pairs — never claims correlation proves causation.
